title: Apple sends invites for a "special Apple Experience" event on March 4 in New York City; rumors suggest an M5 MacBook Pro, entry-level iPad Air, and iPhone 17e (Hartley Charlton/MacRumors)
summary: Hartley Charlton / MacRumors: Apple sends invites for a “special Apple Experience” event on March 4 in New York City; rumors suggest an M5 MacBook Pro, entry-level iPad Air, and iPhone 17e — Apple today announced a “special Apple Experience” in New York, taking place on March 4, 2026 at 9:00am ET.
contentText:
Hartley Charlton / MacRumors :

Apple sends invites for a “special Apple Experience” event on March 4 in New York City; rumors suggest an M5 MacBook Pro, entry-level iPad Air, and iPhone 17e   —  Apple today announced a “special Apple Experience” in New York, taking place on March 4, 2026 at 9:00am ET.
